darkcraft.cap.1.p1: これを読んでいるのなら、お前は昇りの塔を登りきったのだろう。挑む者は少なく、登った時と同じ姿で降りた者はいない。座って、老いぼれの話を聞くがいい。
darkcraft.cap.1.p2: わしの名はアルドゥス。王の年代記作者だった者だ。ヴァルドレンがどんな地であったか、誰かに覚えていてもらうために書いている。雲に届く塔が並び、あらゆる通りを川が歌いながら流れる、王国の宝石だった。
darkcraft.cap.1.p3: 我らが王コルヴィンは、己の王冠よりもイゾルデ王妃を愛していた。灰色の熱病が王妃を蝕み始めたとき、どんな癒し手も、祈りも、供物も、彼女を救えなかった。
darkcraft.cap.1.p4: 月のない夜、王はただ一人、嵐の下へと降りていき、名もなき影と言葉を交わした。王は取引を持ちかけた。王妃の命と……それ以外のすべてを引き換えに、と。
darkcraft.cap.1.p5: 影はそれを受け入れた。その夜、王国はまるごと大地から引き剥がされ、空へと持ち上げられた。以来、川は虚空へと落ち続け、嵐は一日たりとも止んでいない。
darkcraft.cap.1.p6: 誰も死ななかった。それよりも酷いことが起きたのだ。兵も、召使いも、貴族も、魂を失った抜け殻となり、今もこの広間をさまよっている。慈悲は期待するな。彼らはもう、自分の名前さえ覚えていない。
darkcraft.cap.1.p7: 二人の守護者が呪いを生かし続けている。今も玉座の間で座して待つ王と、王に誓いを立てた騎士サー・ガヴランだ。ガヴランは王冠の樹の頂で見張りを続けている。
darkcraft.cap.1.p8:
二人を倒せば、嵐は終わるかもしれん。どうやってかは教えぬ。わしはただ書くだけだ。次のページは、水がまだ歌う場所、大噴水のそばで待っている。

――A
darkcraft.cap.2.p1: 王妃は毎晩ここに座っていた。この噴水のせせらぎを聞くと、海の向こうの故郷を思い出すと言っていた。
darkcraft.cap.2.p2: 王が嵐から戻ったとき、王妃は目を開けた。わしらは狂ったように祝ったものだ。三日の間、中庭には音楽が響き、どの酒蔵にも葡萄酒があふれていた。
darkcraft.cap.2.p3: 四日目、召使いたちは食べるのをやめた。五日目、彼らの目は灰のように濁った。夜明け前になると、綱を引く者もいないのに、鐘がひとりでに鳴り響いた。
darkcraft.cap.2.p4: サー・ガヴランは、誰も逃げ出せず、誰も入れぬよう門を閉ざさせた。たとえ世界のすべてが燃え尽きようとも王を守ると誓い……その誓いを、あまりにも忠実に守り通した。
darkcraft.cap.2.p5: ひとり、またひとりと、わしの仲間は空っぽになっていった。彼らは務めを続けていた。誰もいない広間を掃き、客のいない食卓に給仕し、誰もいない場所で見張りに立っていた。
darkcraft.cap.2.p6: わしだけは変わらなかった。それが影からの贈り物なのか、罰なのかはわからん。すべてを覚えている者が必要なのかもしれん……あるいは、お前に語り聞かせる者が。
darkcraft.cap.2.p7:
王を探せ。王は今も玉座にいて、決して来ることのない王妃を待っている。王が倒れたなら、そのそばにわしの三枚目のページがあるだろう。

――A
darkcraft.cap.3.p1: そうか、王は倒れたか。光よ、まだ残っているのなら、どうか彼に慈悲を。
darkcraft.cap.3.p2: お前は真実を知らねばならん。影は王妃を返したのではない。王妃の顔をした何かを返したのだ。イゾルデは目覚めたが、その笑い声はもう彼女のものではなかった。
darkcraft.cap.3.p3: コルヴィンは最初の口づけで気づいた。それでも、彼は王妃を愛し続けた。毎夜あの玉座に座り、本当のイゾルデが扉から入ってくるのを待っていたのだ。
darkcraft.cap.3.p4: 取引にはもうひとつ代償があった。王冠だ。コルヴィンがそれを戴いている限り、影はこの世に片足を残せる。だから王冠はひび割れ、だから王は決してそれを外さなかった。
darkcraft.cap.3.p5: 今や王冠は完全に砕けた。嵐の唸りが弱まったのが聞こえるか？だが、まだ足りぬ。誓いを守り続けている者が、まだいる。
darkcraft.cap.3.p6: 王妃が王妃でなくなったとき、メロウ司教は彼女を大聖堂の祭壇の下に封じた。それ以来、身廊に足を踏み入れる者は誰もいない。
darkcraft.cap.3.p7:
大聖堂へ行け。四枚目のページは祭壇の足元で待っている。そして、中で聞こえる声には耳を貸すな。

――A
darkcraft.cap.4.p1: この大聖堂は、ヴァルドレンが築いた中で最も美しいものだった。今やその長椅子が待つのは、死者だけだ。
darkcraft.cap.4.p2: メロウ司教は、七つの錠と七つの祈りで王妃をこの祭壇の下に封じた。雷が落ちるたびに、今も彼女がかすかに歌う声が聞こえるという。
darkcraft.cap.4.p3: 王妃が封じられた夜、大地が震え、主塔の中心から一本の樹が芽吹いた。樹はたった一夜で天まで伸び、石も梁も引き裂いていった。
darkcraft.cap.4.p4: わしらはそれを王冠の樹と呼んだ。その根は影から水を吸い、その梢には取引の最後のかけら、サー・ガヴランの誓いが守られている。
darkcraft.cap.4.p5: ガヴランは枝を登り、二度と降りてこなかった。樹とともに育ち、今では三人の男ほどの背丈となり、鎧は肌と溶け合っているという。
darkcraft.cap.4.p6: 彼が生きている限り、嵐は去らぬ。彼は誰ひとり頂へ近づけはせん。見つけうる最上の鋼と、己にあると思う以上の勇気を持っていけ。
darkcraft.cap.4.p7:
王冠の樹を登り、最も高い広間を目指せ。勝利したなら、わしの最後のページは彼の足元にあるだろう。

――A
darkcraft.cap.5.p1: サー・ガヴランは倒れた。その誓いは砕け、それとともに、影をこの石に縛りつけていたものも砕け散った。
darkcraft.cap.5.p2: ありがとう。百年もの間、誰もわしを読んではくれなかった。インクが指からこぼれ落ちていくのを感じる。ようやく、休めそうだ。
darkcraft.cap.5.p3: だが、よく聞け。影はここに棲んでいるのではない。この王国は、ただの扉にすぎなかった。影はずっと遠く、嵐の生まれる場所で待っている。
darkcraft.cap.5.p4: ガヴランは、鉄ではなく骨でできた鍵を守っていた。それを使え。雲の彼方に浮かぶ要塞への道を示してくれるだろう。
darkcraft.cap.5.p5: その先には星に届く山がそびえ、倒れた者たちの篝火が燃える城があるという。そこで人は休み……そしてそこから、また戻ってくるのだ。
darkcraft.cap.5.p6: わしはもう、お前と共には行けぬ。ここから先はお前次第だ。探し、戦い、倒れ、そしてまた立ち上がれ。お前の物語を書くのは、お前の他に誰もおらぬ。
darkcraft.cap.5.p7:
これにて、ヴァルドレンの年代記は終わる。お前の鋼が鈍ることなく、お前の炎が消えることのないように。

――アルドゥス、王の最後の年代記作者
darkcraft.pista.1: 島の南にある昇りの塔の頂上まで登れ。

darkcraft.pista.4: 大聖堂の祭壇の足元。主塔の東にある。
darkcraft.pista.5: 王冠の樹の最も高い広間。サー・ガヴランを倒せ。
darkcraft.pista.6: 年代記は終わった。雲の彼方に浮かぶ要塞を探せ。
darkcraft.narracion.1.1: 砕けた王冠の時代、ヴァルドレンは王国の宝石だった。
darkcraft.narracion.1.2: その塔は雲に届き、川はあらゆる通りを歌いながら流れていた。
darkcraft.narracion.1.3: だがイゾルデ王妃が病に倒れ、どんな癒し手も、祈りも、彼女を救えなかった。
darkcraft.narracion.1.4: そこでコルヴィン王は嵐の下へ降り……名もなき影と契約を結んだ。
darkcraft.narracion.1.5: 王妃の命と……それ以外のすべてを引き換えに。
darkcraft.narracion.1.6: その夜、王国は大地から引き剥がされ、川は虚空へと落ち始めた。
darkcraft.narracion.1.7: ヴァルドレンの民は死ななかった。抜け殻となり……今もこの広間をさまよっている。
darkcraft.narracion.1.8: 主塔の中心から王冠の樹が伸び、その頂では誓いを立てた騎士が見張りを続けている。
darkcraft.narracion.1.9: 王は今も玉座で待ち、騎士は今も空を守っている。
darkcraft.narracion.1.10: 二人を倒せ……そうすれば、ついに嵐は終わるかもしれない。
darkcraft.narracion.5.1: サー・ガヴランは倒れた。その誓いは破られ……それとともに、影をこの石に縛りつけていた鎖も断たれた。
darkcraft.narracion.5.2: ありがとう。この百年、わしの言葉を読む者は誰もいなかった。
darkcraft.narracion.5.3: 指先からインクがこぼれ落ちていくのを感じる。ようやく……眠れそうだ。
darkcraft.narracion.5.4: だが、よく聞け。影はここには住んでいない。この王国は、ただの扉にすぎなかったのだ。
darkcraft.narracion.5.5: 影はもっと遠く……嵐が生まれる場所で待っている。
darkcraft.narracion.5.6: ガヴランは鍵を守っていた。鉄ではなく、骨でできた鍵を。
darkcraft.narracion.5.7: それを使えば、雲の彼方に浮かぶ砦への道を示してくれるだろう。
darkcraft.narracion.5.8: その先には星に届く山がそびえ……倒れた者たちの篝火が燃えているという。
darkcraft.narracion.5.9: わしはもう、共に歩むことはできん。ここから先は、お前のものだ。
darkcraft.narracion.5.10: 探せ。戦え。倒れ……そしてまた立ち上がれ。お前の物語を書けるのは、お前だけだ。
darkcraft.narracion.5.11: ヴァルドレンの年代記は、ここで終わる。その刃が鈍ることなく……その炎が消えることのないように。
darkcraft.rey.voz.1: ようやく……客人か。この玉座で、長く待ちすぎた。
darkcraft.rey.voz.2: 影は余に、終わりなき王国を約束した。それを奪いに来たというのか？
darkcraft.rey.voz.3: ならば王の前にひざまずけ……さもなくば立ったまま死ね！
darkcraft.rey.voz.4: もうよい！燃えよ……我が王国とともに燃えよ！
darkcraft.rey.voz.5: 我が王国が滅ぶというなら、貴様も道連れだ……炎の中へ！
darkcraft.rey.voz.6: 王冠は……最初から、余のものではなかった……
darkcraft.rey.voz.7: また一人、我が宮廷に愚か者が加わったか。
darkcraft.rey.voz.8: それで終わりか？我が衛兵の方がまだましに戦ったぞ。
darkcraft.rey.voz.9: 我が都を喰らい尽くした炎を味わえ！
darkcraft.rey.voz.10: 衣はもういらぬ。宮廷もいらぬ。炎が余を何に変えたか、その目で見よ！
darkcraft.rey.voz.12: ありえん……炎が……貴様に従うだと？
darkcraft.rey.voz.13: また一人……我が宮廷に愚か者か。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.1: そうか……王は死んだか。あの方の心臓が止まった瞬間、根を通して感じた。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.2: あの方は我が王であり、友であった。そして我ら全員を影に売り渡した愚か者だ。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.3: だが、私は誓いを立てた……誓いは、それを聞いた者と共に死にはせぬ。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.4: 剣を抜け。騎士として……決着をつけよう。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.7: 立て、我が従者たちよ。お前たちの誓いはまだ果たされていない。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.8: これが我が王を討った刃か？
darkcraft.gavran.voz.9: よく戦う。だが何も変わらぬ。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.10: もう休め。樹がお前を預かる。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.11: もういい！王冠の樹よ……我に残るものを受け取れ！
darkcraft.gavran.voz.13: 根はお前の勇気より深く伸びている。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.14: この広間に我が手の届かぬ場所などない！
darkcraft.gavran.voz.15: 床は我がものだ。登れ……さもなくば呑まれよ。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.16: 心臓を……心臓を見つけたか……
darkcraft.gavran.voz.17: 見事だ……誓いは破れた……ようやく。
darkcraft.gavran.voz.18: コルヴィン、我が友よ……約束は果たした。樹よ……花を咲かせよ。

darkcraft.perdido.1.p1:
ライ麦粉。
粗塩。
城へ黒い蝋燭を三ダース(黒?執事は理由を言わなかった)。
王妃さまに蜂蜜。
darkcraft.perdido.1.p2:
覚え書き:戻ってから、王妃さまはパンを召し上がらない。蜂蜜も。何も。

それなのに蝋燭は毎晩なくなる。
darkcraft.perdido.2.p1: 母さん、祭りには街へ来ないで。王妃さまが戻られて皆が祝っているけれど、夜の見回りをしていると、庭で笑う声が聞こえるんだ。
darkcraft.perdido.2.p2:
あれは王妃さまの笑い声じゃない。昔は鈴のように笑われた。今は地下墓所に吹き込む風のような音がする。

隊長は口にするなと言う。愛をこめて、
ヨレン
darkcraft.perdido.3.p1:
兄弟たちよ。契約にはインクで結ぶものと、最も愛するもので結ぶものがある。王は後者を結んだ。

影は返さない。貸すのだ。
darkcraft.perdido.3.p2: そして貸したものは、利子をつけて取り立てる。コルヴィンのために祈れ。イゾルデのために祈れ。祈りを聞く何かが、まだ彼女に残っているのなら。
darkcraft.perdido.3.p3: (司教がこれを口にすることはなかった。翌朝、椅子に座ったまま北の雲を見つめている姿で見つかった。)
darkcraft.perdido.4.p1: きょう、お庭で王妃さまを見た。夜で、月が出ていて、ぼくは窓のところにいた。王妃さまは噴水のそばでじっと立っていた。
darkcraft.perdido.4.p2:
像には影があった。木にも影があった。

王妃さまにはなかった。

お母さんは夢だって言う。夢じゃない。
darkcraft.perdido.5.titulo: サー・ガヴランの注文
darkcraft.perdido.5.p1: サー・ガヴランが長く白い骨を持ってきた。牛のものでも馬のものでもなかった。これで鍵を作れ、何も訊くな、と言われた。
darkcraft.perdido.5.p2: 加工は、溶けない氷を削るようだった。仕上がった鍵は温かかった。サー・ガヴランは、これは雲の向こう、遥か彼方の扉を開くのだと言った。
darkcraft.perdido.5.p3:
誰もこれを使わずに済むことを願う、とも言った。

まるで祈るように。
darkcraft.perdido.6.p1:
天の門を守ると誓う。
骨の鍵を持たぬ者には開かぬと誓う。
眠らぬと誓う。
死なぬと誓う。
darkcraft.perdido.6.p2:
(その下に、別の筆跡で)

四つとも守った。
最後の一つは、望んだわけではない。
darkcraft.perdido.7.p1:
四十日目。夜になると石がひとりでに上がっていく。誰も押していない。王は、影が手を貸しているのだと言う。

私は助けなど頼んでいない。
darkcraft.perdido.7.p2: 七十七日目。もう雲の上だ。ここからヴァルドレンは見えないが、遠くで太鼓のようにその嵐が聞こえる。
darkcraft.perdido.7.p3:
百三日目。城壁のために骨が運ばれてきた。大量に。獣の骨だという。

私は生涯獣を葬ってきたが、こんな骨は見たことがない。
darkcraft.perdido.8.titulo: サー・アルドリックの最後の手紙
darkcraft.perdido.8.p1: これを読む者がいるなら、もう門を守っているのは私ではない。冷たさが脚を、胸を這い上がってくる。他の者はもう話さない。兜の中でうなるだけだ。
darkcraft.perdido.8.p2:
我らに近づくな。慈悲を乞うな。もう与え方を覚えていない。

鍵を持っているなら、急いで登れ。そして、我らを許してくれ。
darkcraft.perdido.9.p1:
愛しいコルヴィン。戻ってくれと言われたから、戻りました。

どうしてもう、私の目を見てくれないの?
darkcraft.perdido.9.p2: ここは心地いいわ。寒くて、誰も泣かない。影は、もうすぐ一番上の扉を開くと言っている。そうすればヴァルドレンのすべてが私のようになるって。
darkcraft.perdido.9.p3:
静かで、黙して、永遠に。

それがあなたの望みだったでしょう?
darkcraft.perdido.10.titulo: 門についての覚え書き
darkcraft.perdido.10.p1: 塔の頂に、どこへも通じぬ拱門がある。日が当たっていても石は冷たい。
darkcraft.perdido.10.p2: 力でも炎でも開かない。それが覚えているものに応える。誓いの骨、ダイヤモンドの光、冥府の金属。
darkcraft.perdido.10.p3:
開く者は向こう側を見る。くぐる者は二度と元には戻らない。

私は確かめるつもりはない。
darkcraft.perdido.11.p1:
昼の番:全員。
夜の番:全員。
交代:なし。

城壁で眠った者は、二度と目覚めるな。
darkcraft.perdido.12.p1:
To whoever can still read:

The Grey Heron will not sail again. The Captain has ordered her taken apart, and what he orders in Brumavela is still done.
darkcraft.perdido.12.p2: The sail, to the warehouse on the quay. The tavern keeper kept the helm, for what the crew owes her. The friars guard the new mast in the crypt: it is blessed wood.
darkcraft.perdido.12.p3:
Of the anchor I only know they lowered poor Tobias with it down the Ledge, and the chain is still there.

And the heart he carried up to the lighthouse himself. He says that while it burns, our own will find the way back.
darkcraft.perdido.13.p1:
Nobody pays any more. They sit, stare at the mug and do not drink. Yesterday I spoke to young Hobb and it took him a long while to turn his head.

There was no one behind his eyes.
darkcraft.perdido.13.p2:
They say it is the mist, rising from the sea of clouds ever since the King of Valdrenn did what he did.

I have hung the Heron's helm behind the bar. If they come for it, let them. I am not waiting for anyone.
darkcraft.perdido.14.p1: Brumavela had three founders, and three bells bear their names: the Fisherman's looks to the quay, the Weaver's to the north and the Keeper's to his lighthouse.
darkcraft.perdido.14.p2:
When the last of us falls silent, let them ring in the order in which the founders left, and the crypt will open to make room for us.

Their gravestones do not lie: they stand at the foot of the chapel.
darkcraft.perdido.15.autor: Tobias, topman of the Grey Heron
darkcraft.perdido.15.p1: Lena: the Captain says the island is slipping away, that the mist is dragging it, and he means to moor it to the clouds with the Heron's anchor. Tomorrow I go down the Ledge with it.
darkcraft.perdido.15.p2:
Do not laugh. You have not seen the ship's heart beat: a storm stone, blue, that sings very softly. That is what makes the Heron fly. That is how we will get back to Valdrenn.

Keep my supper for me.
darkcraft.perdido.16.autor: Edrik Maroll, captain of the Grey Heron
darkcraft.perdido.16.p1: I took the Heron apart with my own hands. If no one can leave, no one will carry this to another island. So I told myself.
darkcraft.perdido.16.p2:
I carried the heart up to the lighthouse. While it burns, those who fell into the sea of clouds will find their way home.

And they did. God help us: they did.
darkcraft.perdido.16.p3:
They come up from the quay every night, dripping mist, and they do not know me. I no longer know myself.

Whoever reads this: do not take the heart. Or take it, and take us with you.
darkcraft.perdido.17.autor: Oswin, last watchman of the dome
darkcraft.perdido.17.p1: There were twelve of us watchmen beneath the dome. We kept the garden, Maester Velan's tower and, by night, in turns, the door at the very top. No one ever told us what it guarded.
darkcraft.perdido.17.p2:
When the sky turned red, the other eleven went up to look. They never came down. Now they walk the garden with burning eyes and fade away if you look at them.

I hid down here, beneath the fountain.
darkcraft.perdido.17.p3:
The maester's treasure is not in the armoury. It lies behind the wall that is no wall: in the cellar, in the west guardroom. Strike it well and it crumbles like ash.

May he forgive me. No one needs it now.
darkcraft.perdido.18.p1: I have rung the bell of Velmor for as long as I can remember: for mass, for fire, for the dead. When the sky turned red over the heart of the land, I rang it for fire. No one came.
darkcraft.perdido.18.p2: They did not die. They stayed. The miller's wife is still in her field, reaping what no longer grows; the smith strikes a cold anvil; no one drinks in the tavern. We broke the bridge so that nothing would come. It made no difference: what withers us does not travel by road.
darkcraft.perdido.18.p3:
They are walking ash, and ash thirsts for whatever still breathes. If you hear my bell, it is not mass: it means someone living has entered Velmor, and they know it.

I hear it now from the inside too.
darkcraft.perdido.19.autor: Master Odran, hangman of the Grove
darkcraft.perdido.19.p1: Year of the red sky. Hanged in the Grove: two horse thieves, the miller of Brezal (stolen grain), three deserters of the Oath and a woman who said the Shadow spoke to her in dreams. All as the law commands.
darkcraft.perdido.19.p2: They bring no one anymore: there is no one left to judge. But the ropes creak all the same, and this morning the miller had his eyes open. He was watching me. I cut two of them down and they walked off among the trees.
darkcraft.perdido.19.p3:
If you read this, cut no rope and do not walk beneath the branches. I am staying with them. Someone has to keep the count... and the tree still has room.

O.
darkcraft.perdido.20.autor: Sister Ilse, of the chapel on the stilts
darkcraft.perdido.20.p1: Since the sky turned red, the water of the lagoon is black. The fish float belly up and no one eats them. The nets come up full of something that is not fish. This morning I blessed the water three times; three times it darkened again.
darkcraft.perdido.20.p2: Those who drown do not stay at the bottom. They rise to the surface bloated, face down, and one night they stand up. At night there are green lights among the reeds: the children follow them and never come back. Do not follow the lights.
darkcraft.perdido.20.p3:
The ferryman still crosses the lagoon, though there is no one left to carry. I hear him rowing beneath the chapel. Today he knocked at the door. I pray with the water up to my knees: if you read this, do not board his boat.

Sr. Ilse
darkcraft.perdido.21.titulo: What I Saw from the Gatehouse
darkcraft.perdido.21.autor: Brother Wendel, gatekeeper of the Frostbound Monastery
darkcraft.perdido.21.p1: For forty winters I have opened this gate to the pilgrims. They climbed waist-deep in snow to pray with us at the Frost. Since the sky turned red no one comes up anymore... and those who were already on the road never arrived.
darkcraft.perdido.21.p2: The cold came into the church during vespers. Father Prior bade us keep praying: "the Lord does not forsake His own". We prayed until we could no longer move. The brothers are still there, kneeling in the pews, frost in their beards. Sometimes I hear them whisper.
darkcraft.perdido.21.p3:
Abbot Hrodric did not pray with us. He climbed to the summit to beg the cold to spare us, and the cold answered him. I have seen him come down at night, taller than the tower, wearing a mitre of ice. If you read this, do not climb to the summit. And never kneel in this house.

Br. Wendel
darkcraft.perdido.22.titulo: The Watch of the West Gate
darkcraft.perdido.22.autor: Sergeant Brannoc, of the Oath Guard
darkcraft.perdido.22.p1: Night of the red sky. The Constable orders the West Gate shut: no one comes in, no one goes out. The bridge watch had not yet come back. We lowered the portcullis with them calling from the other side. I write that down too.
darkcraft.perdido.22.p2: Across the river the palace was burning. That fire did not catch on the roofs: it fell from the sky, red, and water would not put it out. Those inside threw themselves against the gate to get out. We held it. That is what we swore.
darkcraft.perdido.22.p3:
"I swear to guard the gate. I swear not to sleep. I swear not to die."

We sleep no more. We burn without burning away and we keep to the wall-walk. The Constable says the gate is still shut. If you read this, you come from outside... and no one passes this gate.

Sgt. Brannoc
darkcraft.perdido.23.autor: Ser Halvard, Constable of the Oath
darkcraft.perdido.23.p1: To the Oath Guard, at every gate. Tonight the sky burns and fire falls upon the palace. If it leaves these walls, the whole kingdom will burn. Shut the gates. No one comes in and no one goes out: not the people, not the guard, not I.
darkcraft.perdido.23.p2: I hear the people in the streets. They beat on the portcullis, they call me by my name. I hold the order. That is what we swore: to guard the gate, not to sleep, not to die. I swore it first, here, before the stone. If I am wrong, let the sky judge me... not them.
darkcraft.perdido.23.p3:
If someone reads this, my gate has opened and I guard it no more. Then there is no oath left to keep. Open the gates. Let them go home.

Ser Halvard, Constable of the Oath
darkcraft.perdido.24.autor: Master Orlen, Keeper of the Great Library
darkcraft.perdido.24.p1: Night of the red sky. Rector Ysolde has gone up to the observatory with her masters to read the fire that falls. She says it is not fire: it is writing. Those of us below she has bidden to keep studying and not go out. The custodians have chained the tomes.
darkcraft.perdido.24.p2: The apprentices sleep no more. They read without turning the page; if you speak to them, they answer with the line in front of them. The vein sings beneath the cloister. No one comes down from the observatory, but the Rector's light still burns.
darkcraft.perdido.24.p3:
If you are reading this, do not read it aloud: what they read stays with you. To the east, in the observatory, the Rector is still reading the sky... and the sky is reading her.

Master Orlen, Keeper of the Great Library
darkcraft.perdido.25.p1: Night of the red sky, third hour. The fire falling on the capital is not fire: it is lines. They join stars that were on no chart. I have sent my masters to their lecterns and closed the door with the seal. No one goes down until we have read it all.
darkcraft.perdido.25.p2: Sixth hour. I can read it now. It is a name, written with the stars of the whole sky, and it is no one's name who was ever born. The more I read it, the clearer it shows. My masters no longer speak: they copy. I cannot take my eye from the telescope.
darkcraft.perdido.25.p3:
I do not know the hour. This night does not end. It is no longer I who read: something reads me, line by line, from above. If anyone finds these pages, do not look through the telescope. And if you see me still standing before it, make me lower my eyes. Please.

Ysolde
darkcraft.perdido.26.autor: Tomé, keeper of the Stranded Harbour's light
darkcraft.perdido.26.p1: Night of the red sky. At high tide the sea went away. It did not ebb: it went, all at once, as if someone had drunk it. The boats were left lying on the sand, and the whale that followed the fleet was stranded in the middle of the bay.
darkcraft.perdido.26.p2: At dawn everyone went down onto the sand to gather the fish, the shells, whatever the sea had left. I shouted from the gallery for them to come up. They did not. The sea did not come back, and the salt began to creep up their legs. Now they are still down there, at work.
darkcraft.perdido.26.p3:
I have lit the lighthouse with cold fire: it is the only thing that still burns. If anyone reads this, do not go down into the bay. And do not go north, to the Ribcage: old Brann the whaler is still there, harpooning a whale that has long been gone.

Tomé, keeper of the Stranded Harbour's light
darkcraft.perdido.27.autor: Brann, harpooner of the Stranded Harbour
darkcraft.perdido.27.p1: First day without the sea. The Old One was in range when the water went: I saw her sink into the sand as if the sand were the sea. Forty years after her, and she slips me like that. Her sister whale was stranded here; I have made my home in her ribs.
darkcraft.perdido.27.p2: I no longer know the day. The salt has climbed to my chest and I am no longer hungry. Every night I hear her singing under the sand, and in the morning I see her spout out there, to the east. I have sharpened the harpoon and filled the lantern with oil. When she surfaces, I will be awake.
darkcraft.perdido.27.p3:
If anyone reads this: keep away from the ribs. My boat lies overturned and my men went back to the harbour to mend nets that are no use anymore. I stay. The Old One will surface, and this time she will not slip me. After that, let the tide come back.

Brann
darkcraft.perdido.28.autor: Brother Ulric, hospitaller of the Bridge of the Rift
darkcraft.perdido.28.p1: Since the night of the red sky the pilgrims have not stopped coming. They come from the south, barefoot, to beg forgiveness of the crater. I give them bread and a straw bed, and in the morning I ring the bridge bell for each one who crosses. They used to cross singing.
darkcraft.perdido.28.p2: Today he arrived, at the head of the last procession: Anselm, who calls himself Pontiff. He says the sky took our faith and only blood can buy it back. The pilgrims listen to him with empty eyes. No one slept tonight: all one could hear was the lash.
darkcraft.perdido.28.p3:
He leads them northwest, to the Altar of Blood, beyond the rifts, where the earth is reddest. They come back from there with their faces hooded and their backs laid open, and they no longer cross: they pray. If anyone reads this, do not ring the bell. They come.

Brother Ulric
darkcraft.perdido.29.p1: Brothers: we went to the crater to beg forgiveness and no one answered. For years we prayed to the empty sky. And on the night of the red sky, at last, something answered. It did not say forgiven. It said: give.
darkcraft.perdido.29.p2: So we give. Our backs, so that the sky sees we keep nothing back. Our blood, for the altar, which is always thirsty. Those who doubted left by the southern road; I no longer name them. Those who stayed are no longer afraid: they no longer have anything.
darkcraft.perdido.29.p3:
(in another hand, shaking) Blood is not enough. It is never enough. The altar drinks it and the voice of the crater asks for more. If anyone reads this: the voice does not forgive. It collects. And what it collects it carries to the centre, to the red lake, where it waits.

Anselm
darkcraft.perdido.30.p1: I woke at the bottom of the crater with the mark burning on my chest and a voice in my head. 'You were dead,' it said. 'Break my chains and you shall rest.' I found the nearest chain and began to strike it. I did not know how much the Shadow's iron weighs.
darkcraft.perdido.30.p2: Then others came, one by one, with the same mark and the same promise. We are many now, and the chain is only one. We strike in turns, day and night, though here it is never night. The anchor has not moved a finger's breadth. Our hands no longer hurt: they are no longer ours.
darkcraft.perdido.30.p3:
Today I climbed the chain, link by link, until I saw the citadel up close. There is no door up there: there is a mouth that waits. I came down. I will not climb again, and I will let no one who bears the mark climb it. The voice was wrong. It was never about rest.

Aldric
darkcraft.perdido.31.autor: King Corvin, by the hand of Ser Lucan, his herald
darkcraft.perdido.31.p1:
(On the envelope, under the King's seal) To the Warden of the Bone Fortress. Let my herald carry it along the cloud road, and let him not stop until he reaches the stair.

(Inside, in the King's hand) Warden: the queen has come back, and she is not herself. I made a bargain I should never have made.
darkcraft.perdido.31.p2:
Whatever answered me waits on the other side of the door at the top of your tower. Close it and open it to no one: not to whoever wears my crown, not to whoever speaks with my voice. If another letter reaches you with my seal and another hand, burn it. If I myself climb up and knock, do not open.

Corvin
darkcraft.perdido.31.p3:
(On the back, in another hand, shaking) I did not arrive. Something caught me on the road that night, and ever since I ride and never arrive: every time I see the stair, the dawn comes. If anyone reads this, let them carry it. And tell them I rode every night.

Lucan
darkcraft.perdido.32.titulo: The Playbill of the Last Performance
darkcraft.perdido.32.autor: The Company of the Royal Theater of Morvain
darkcraft.perdido.32.p1: ROYAL THEATER OF MORVAIN. Tonight, before His Majesty and the whole court: 'The Paper Crown', a comedy in three acts. With Pell, the King's jester, in every part no one else wanted. Music by the drums of the guard. No swords allowed in the stands.
darkcraft.perdido.32.p2:
Act one: the king who could not laugh. Act two: the three Pells (let no one know which one is real). Act three: the royal door, through which the King comes out...

(In another ink) Rehearsed a thousand times. The King has promised to come. The King always comes.
darkcraft.perdido.32.p3:
(On the back, in a shaking hand) The sky turned red in the middle of the second act. Everyone ran. They bricked up the royal door with me behind it, and the orchestra burned. I am still waiting for the third act. If anyone reads this: the door is not made of stone. It never was. Strike it and come in.

Pell
darkcraft.perdido.33.autor: Odo, watchman of the Raven's Watchtower
darkcraft.perdido.33.p1: Thirty years guarding the pass alongside Vorthak. He flies over the peaks at dawn and we light the beacon as he passes. The kings pay him in gold, a cartload every winter, and he sleeps on it. He says the gold is warm like the sun used to be. He has never harmed a hair on our heads.
darkcraft.perdido.33.p2: On the night of the red sky Vorthak did not return to his ledge: he circled and circled, looking up, roaring at the sky, as if something had been stolen from him. At dawn he came down upon the tower. He was not looking at us. Something was burning inside him, and he poured it out of his mouth.
darkcraft.perdido.33.p3:
The tower burned with the garrison inside. I was at the beacon and hid beneath the flagstones. Those who climb up to kill him end up in his gold. If anyone reads this: his fire does not reach behind the rocks, and when his wings grow heavy he comes down to earth. Do not look him in the eye.

Odo
darkcraft.perdido.34.autor: Ivo, the last on the rope
darkcraft.perdido.34.p1: Day twelve of the climb. We have nailed down the last plank of the Landing. Aldric says that from here you can already hear the citadel breathing. The gargoyles on the pedestals leave us alone if we crouch as we pass; the flying ones are another matter. The wind took Mattis over the east side. Now we go crouching.
darkcraft.perdido.34.p2: Day fourteen. Aldric climbed alone up to the Maw. He came back running, without his sword and without a word. He passed the hut without looking at us and kept going down, all the way, to the anchor. From here you can see him far below, on his knees. He does not move.
darkcraft.perdido.34.p3:
Day twenty. No one wants to go up. No one wants to go down. The mark burns when we look up, and burns more when we look down. Tonight I dreamed of the Maw: there is no door, only teeth. If you make it this far, rest by the fire. Then decide for yourself whether you run.

Ivo
darkcraft.perdido.35.p1: Corvin brought me back. I remember the fountain in the courtyard, the sound of the water, and then nothing. I woke in a bed that was not mine and he was weeping. I wonder why I can no longer hear the fountain. I wonder why I am never hungry.
darkcraft.perdido.35.p2: Some days I write, and some days something writes with my hand. Today I saw the guard of the citadel: suits of armor that walk on their own, with smoke inside. She says they are loyal, that they never learned how to die. She is me, they say. She is not.
darkcraft.perdido.35.p3:
If anyone reads this: when she sings, do not look at her. Her lullaby closes the eyes of whoever watches her sing. Turn your back and wait. And if this ever ends, let someone tell Corvin it was not his fault. It was never me who came back.

I.
darkcraft.acertijo.p1: 頂の扉を開きたい者は、護符を鍛えねばならない。落ち着いて読む者にだけ分かるよう、詩にして書き残す。
darkcraft.acertijo.p2:
砕けぬ二つの光が
炉の上に冠し、
そのあいだに眠るは
冥府の鉄。

その下で、誓いを守る骨が
同じ鉄の
二人の兄弟に挟まれて
眠る。
darkcraft.acertijo.p3: インクが手強ければ、下の封蝋を押すがよい。本が描かれた炉を見せてくれる。
darkcraft.narracion.6.1: そうか……刻印の者よ、ついに我が扉まで登ってきたか。
darkcraft.narracion.6.2: 王は王妃を求めて私に縋った。騎士は私を締め出すために魂を捧げた。
darkcraft.narracion.6.3: 奴らは失敗した。だが、お前は違う。
darkcraft.narracion.6.4: お前は自らの手で護符を鍛え……そして私の扉を開いた。
darkcraft.narracion.6.5: 礼を言おう。千の冬を、私はその手を待っていた。
darkcraft.narracion.6.7: 空は私の名を覚えている。
darkcraft.narracion.6.8: この世界の雲はすべて赤く燃える……お前が私の前に立つまで。
darkcraft.narracion.6.9: この扉の向こうには枯れた地、モルヴェインがある。我が地だ。
darkcraft.narracion.6.10: 渡れ、刻印の者よ。すべての中心で待っている。
darkcraft.narracion.6.11: 私はいつも待っている。
darkcraft.cap.6.p1: そうか……刻印の者よ、ついに我が扉まで登ってきたか。王は王妃を求めて私に縋った。騎士は私を締め出すために魂を捧げた。奴らは失敗した。だが、お前は違う。
darkcraft.cap.6.p2: お前は自らの手で護符を鍛え……そして私の扉を開いた。礼を言おう。千の冬を、私はその手を待っていた。
darkcraft.cap.6.p3: さあ……空を見よ。空は私の名を覚えている。この世界の雲はすべて赤く燃える……お前が私の前に立つまで。
darkcraft.cap.6.p4: この扉の向こうには枯れた地、モルヴェインがある。我が地だ。渡れ、刻印の者よ。すべての中心で待っている。私はいつも待っている。
darkcraft.narracion.7.1: Before the Shadow, this was Morvain... a kingdom of bells and mills and harbours, of scholars who read the stars.
darkcraft.narracion.7.2: Its people swore oaths the way others breathe. The Constable swore to guard the gate. The Abbot swore to keep the faith.
darkcraft.narracion.7.3: Then came the night of the red sky. Fire fell on the palace... and the sea was drunk in a single breath.
darkcraft.narracion.7.4: The bell of Velmor rang for fire. No one came.
darkcraft.narracion.7.5: They did not die, marked one. They stayed. Each of them bound to the last thing they swore.
darkcraft.narracion.7.6: The miller still reaps a field that will not grow. The hangman still waits beneath his tree.
darkcraft.narracion.7.7: And at the heart of it all, above the crater of blood, the citadel hangs from its eight chains.
darkcraft.narracion.7.8: That is where it waits. That is where it brought you back to go.
darkcraft.narracion.7.9: Rest when you can. Every fire you light is one more step towards it.

darkcraft.narracion.8.1: Ser Halvard closed the gates of the capital so the fire would not spread. He closed them on his own people.
darkcraft.narracion.8.2: The Rector climbed her tower to read the falling fire... and the stars read her instead.
darkcraft.narracion.8.3: The Abbot climbed the summit to beg the cold for mercy. The cold answered him.
darkcraft.narracion.8.4: The ferryman still rows the black lagoon for the drowned, though there is no one left to carry.
darkcraft.narracion.8.5: Brann waits for a sea that will never return. Anselmo bleeds for a god that only ever answered: give.
darkcraft.narracion.8.6: None of them chose to stay. The Shadow took their oaths and left the rest of them behind.
darkcraft.narracion.8.7: When you strike them down, you do not kill them. You let them keep their word... one last time.
darkcraft.narracion.8.8: Remember their names, marked one. In Morvain, no one else does.

darkcraft.narracion.9.1: Aldric was the first. He woke at the bottom of the crater with the mark burning in his chest... and a voice that said: break my chains.
darkcraft.narracion.9.2: Others came after him, one by one. They struck the chain in turns, day and night, until their hands were no longer their own.
darkcraft.narracion.9.3: The iron my sisters forged does not break, marked one. It was never meant to.
darkcraft.narracion.9.4: So Aldric climbed. Link by link, up the southern chain, to see the citadel with his own eyes.
darkcraft.narracion.9.5: There was no door at the top. Only a mouth... waiting.
darkcraft.narracion.9.6: He came down running, and he never climbed again. He knelt by the anchor so that no one else would.
darkcraft.narracion.9.7: The Shadow does not need its chains broken. It needs a door opened... by a living hand.
darkcraft.narracion.9.8: Yours is the first hand to come this far. I do not know whether to be glad.

darkcraft.narracion.10.1: A thousand winters ago, the Shadow came to Morvain hungry... and my sisters met it with fire.
darkcraft.narracion.10.2: They forged eight chains in the fire of their own souls, and bound it in the sky, above the crater, where nothing could reach it.
darkcraft.narracion.10.3: Then they scattered across the land and lit the fires you rest beside. Each fire is a sister... keeping watch.
darkcraft.narracion.10.4: But a chain is only as strong as the oaths around it. King Corvin of Valdrenn broke his... for a queen.
darkcraft.narracion.10.5: Through that broken oath the Shadow reached out, and the sky of Morvain turned red.
darkcraft.narracion.10.6: One by one, my sisters went out. I am the last. This is the last flame.
darkcraft.narracion.10.7: Above us, the Shadow will offer you everything. Its heart. Its crown. A life that death can never touch.
darkcraft.narracion.10.8: I cannot choose for you, marked one. I can only keep the fire lit... until you come back.

darkcraft.hechizo.otro_catalizador: That spell cannot be cast with what you hold.
darkcraft.hechizo.no_requisito: You lack the attribute that spell requires.
darkcraft.hechizo.sin_catalizador: You need the staff or the seal in hand.
darkcraft.hechizo.sin_memoria: You have no memory left for that spell.
darkcraft.menu.santuario.memoria.desc: Choose which spells you keep in memory. More fit the higher your Mind.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.1: Another soul the Shadow has dragged back from the dark... You should be dead, marked one. And yet... the fire still answers to you.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.2: I am Maelis. I tend the soul fires, as my sisters did... before Valdrenn fell to its oath.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.3: Rest beside them when you can. The fire mends your flesh and fills your flasks... but the fallen will rise again.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.4: It is older than the kingdom. It feeds on broken oaths... and it hungers for a door. Yours is the hand it chose to open it.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.5: Because it needs you. Each time you fall, it pulls you back... and your echoes stay behind, in a sword of light. Do not lose them twice.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.6: Then give me the echoes you carry. I will weave them into your flesh... and your bones.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.7: May the fire keep you, marked one.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.8: You have returned. Good... the fire was waiting for you.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.9: The king's oath is broken at last. I felt every fire burn brighter... and the Shadow grow hungrier.
darkcraft.dialogo.guia.10: Ser Gavran kept his oath to the very end. Honor him, marked one... few in Valdrenn ever did.
darkcraft.dialogo.combate: This is no time to talk: enemies are near.
darkcraft.dialogo.sin_santuario: That needs a kindled sanctuary nearby.
advancements.darkcraft.maelis.title: Keeper of the Fires
advancements.darkcraft.maelis.descriptio: Speak with Maelis beside a sanctuary
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.1: Hm. Another one crawling out of the dark with a dull blade... The name's Dorvan. I keep the forge of Valdrenn burning, oath or no oath.
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.2: Back again? Show me what you've been swinging.
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.3: Bring me forging stones and echoes, and I'll make that steel sing.
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.4: There. Sharper than the day it was forged. Try not to break it on the first skull.
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.5: You're short on stones, or on echoes. The forge doesn't work for free.
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.6: The king swore an oath to something that should never have heard it. After that... the forge was all I had left to keep my hands from shaking.
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.7: Off you go, then. And keep your guard up.
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.8: That one's as good as it gets. Not even I can push it further.
darkcraft.dialogo.herrero.op.mejorar: I want to upgrade my weapon.
darkcraft.dialogo.mercader.1: Ah, a customer! And a living one, more or less. Kerrick's the name. If it can be carried, I've probably got it.
darkcraft.dialogo.mercader.2: Welcome back, friend! Echoes in your pocket, wares on my cart.
darkcraft.dialogo.mercader.3: A fine choice. Spend it well... or don't, and come buy another.
darkcraft.dialogo.mercader.4: Ah... your purse is lighter than your ambition, friend.
darkcraft.dialogo.mercader.5: The dead don't care much for my prices. The living do. So I stay close to the fires... and closer to my cart.
darkcraft.dialogo.mercader.6: Safe roads, friend. And if you find any... do tell me.
darkcraft.forja.nada: You carry nothing that can be upgraded: weapons, staves or seals.
darkcraft.forja.tope: Fully upgraded: no smith can push it any further.
darkcraft.forja.piedra.desc: Smiths need it to upgrade weapons from +%s to +%s.
darkcraft.forja.sin_herrero: Only a blacksmith knows how to work this anvil.
advancements.darkcraft.dorvan.title: The Blacksmith of Valdrenn
advancements.darkcraft.dorvan.descriptio: Speak with Dorvan at his forge in the training yard
advancements.darkcraft.kerrick.title: A Living Customer
advancements.darkcraft.kerrick.descripti: Speak with Kerrick, the wandering merchant
advancements.darkcraft.mejora.title: Make the Steel Sing
advancements.darkcraft.mejora.descriptio: Upgrade a weapon at a smith's forge
advancements.darkcraft.mejora_maxima.des: Bring a weapon or a catalyst to +9
advancements.darkcraft.compra.title: A Fine Choice
darkcraft.diario.maelis: A hooded woman tends the soul fires. Her name is Maelis... and she says the Shadow chose me.
darkcraft.diario.dorvan: In the training yard, a blacksmith still beats his anvil as if nothing had happened. His name is Dorvan.
darkcraft.diario.kerrick: A merchant with a pack bigger than himself sells by the fires. He says only the living complain about his prices.
darkcraft.diario.mejora: A smith tempered my weapon. Sharper than the day it was forged.
darkcraft.diario.mejora_maxima: My weapon cannot get any better. Not even Dorvan himself would know how.
darkcraft.diario.compra: I bought something from Kerrick. Not sure it was a good idea... he looked very pleased.
darkcraft.habilidad.torbellino.desc: A full spin with the weapon: strikes everything around you twice.
darkcraft.habilidad.estocada.desc: Lunge forward with a thrust that pierces everything in its line.
darkcraft.habilidad.grito.desc: A roar that sets the blood aflame: weapons hit 20% harder for 20 seconds.
darkcraft.habilidad.sismo.desc: Leap and slam the ground with all your weight: the shockwave hits and lifts everyone around.
darkcraft.habilidad.paso.desc: A quick shadow step in the direction you move; nothing can touch you while it lasts.
darkcraft.habilidad.llamas.desc: A wide slash wreathed in fire that sets ablaze whoever it hits.
darkcraft.habilidad.escarcha.desc: An icy slash that freezes and slows whoever it hits.
darkcraft.habilidad.relampago.desc: An overhead slash that releases a bolt of lightning straight ahead.
darkcraft.habilidad.sangre.desc: A devastating slash paid for with your own blood.
darkcraft.habilidad.parada.desc: Deflects a blow from the front at the right moment and staggers whoever struck it.
darkcraft.habilidad.sin_vida: Not enough health to pay for the Bloody Slash.
darkcraft.forja.nada_cenizas: You carry no weapon that accepts ashes (named weapons have their own arts).
darkcraft.forja.sin_cenizas: You carry no Ashes of War.
darkcraft.forja.no_vale: That ash doesn't suit this weapon.
subtitles.darkcraft.sfx.ceniza_aplicar: An ash fuses into a weapon
advancements.darkcraft.ceniza.title: Ashes of War
advancements.darkcraft.ceniza.descriptio: Put an Ash of War on a weapon at Dorvan's forge
advancements.darkcraft.parada.title: At the Perfect Moment
advancements.darkcraft.parada.descriptio: Deflect a blow with a parry
darkcraft.diario.ceniza: Dorvan fused an Ash of War into my weapon. It can do things it couldn't before.
darkcraft.diario.parada: I deflected a blow at the perfect moment. My attacker was left reeling.
darkcraft.menu.historia.bloqueado: You haven't found this chapter yet. Its chest awaits you somewhere in Valdrenn.

darkcraft.opciones.sonido.desc: The volume of everything and the sound device.
darkcraft.opciones.graficos.desc: Render distance, quality, particles, fullscreen... (with Embeddium, its own options).
darkcraft.opciones.controles.desc: The mouse, jumping and sneaking, and every key.

darkcraft.opciones.accesibilidad.desc: Narrator, subtitles, screen effects and flashes.

darkcraft.opciones.lejania.desc: Distant Horizons: how far away the world can be seen.
darkcraft.opciones.mods.desc: The installed mods, their options and the mods folder.
darkcraft.titulo.memoria: Not much memory for the view distance and shaders (%s GB): give the launcher 8 GB in its settings
darkcraft.clase.subtitulo: Who you were before the Shadow brought you back to life
darkcraft.clase.caballero.desc: A lordless knight in heavy armour. Sword, shield and a body that can take a beating.
darkcraft.clase.vagabundo.desc: A wanderer of the roads: nimble, with sword and bow. Fights fast, and from afar when needed.
darkcraft.clase.barbaro.desc: Brute strength and an axe that splits shields. Little finesse, a lot of hitting.
darkcraft.clase.guerrero.desc: A sword in each hand and light feet. Dexterity is their strength.
darkcraft.clase.bandido.desc: Lives off the shadows: dagger, bow and luck on their side (arcane).
darkcraft.clase.hechicero.desc: Studied the Shadow's forbidden sorceries. A staff, three spells and little armour.
darkcraft.clase.profeta.desc: Speaks with what lies beyond. Sacred seal, miracles of healing and fire, and a spear.
darkcraft.clase.confesor.desc: A knight of the faith: sword and shield, and miracles to heal and bless the blade.
darkcraft.clase.prisionero.desc: Escaped with the cage still on their head. Sword and sorceries: clever and quick.
darkcraft.clase.desdichado.desc: Has nothing: no armour, no trade. Everything at 10. For those who would make themselves.
advancements.darkcraft.clase.title: Marked by the Shadow
advancements.darkcraft.clase.description: Choose who you were before you awoke
darkcraft.diario.clase: I awoke without knowing how. I should be dead. I know who I was, and that will have to be enough.
darkcraft.cartel.pieza: Piece of the Grey Heron · %s of %s
darkcraft.pueblo.lapida.pescador: Hobb the Fisherman. The clouds took him in the year 187.
darkcraft.pueblo.lapida.tejedora: Edda the Weaver. She fell asleep at her loom in the year 198.
darkcraft.pueblo.lapida.farero: Aldric the Keeper. He put out his light in the year 212.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.1: The Grey Heron is still missing one piece.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.2: The Grey Heron is still missing two pieces.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.3: The Grey Heron is still missing three pieces.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.4: The Grey Heron is still missing four pieces.
darkcraft.pueblo.faltan.5: The Grey Heron is missing her sail, helm, mast, anchor and heart.
darkcraft.pueblo.campanas.mal: The bells fall silent. That was not the order.
darkcraft.pueblo.cripta: In the chapel, a slab slides aside.
darkcraft.pueblo.sin_rumbo: The Grey Heron cannot find a heading.
darkcraft.pueblo.llegada: The Grey Heron leaves you at the foot of the Tower of Ascent.
darkcraft.pueblo.no_aqui: There is no Brumavela here (a cloud world is needed).
